column3: It's so quiet...\nThe forest is holding\nits breath.{end_wait}
This tree...was a person.{end_wait}
Everyone in Kolima has\nbeen turned into a tree.{end_wait}
It's horrible. These\ntrees in clothes are\nKolima's villagers!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}My mind!!!\nSomeone{pause_20_skippable} is attacking my{em_dash}{end_wait}
We have to get\nout of here!{end_wait}
Oh, no...{pause_20_skippable}\nIf it touches us,\nwe'll become trees!{end_wait}
It was our Psynergy.{end_wait}
What are you saying?{end_wait}
You're lying, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
When I trained, I'd\nfocus so hard my head\nfelt ready to burst.{end_wait}
Maybe it's easier for\nyou, but when I use\nPsynergy...{end_wait}
But what? You can only\nuse Psynergy by\nconcentrating!{end_wait}
That means some Psynergy\nacts only when it's\nneeded.{end_wait}
You mean, when we're\nin danger?{end_wait}

Maybe like a critical
hit in battle.{page_break}We can't control it,
but it's there when
we need it.{end_wait}
Could we use this power\nat will, {actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Yes. We have to learn\nto master it.{end_wait}
You...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nYou're not really\ninterested, are you?{end_wait}
Hroom!{pause_20_skippable} Why?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} Why do they not\nturn into trees...?{end_wait}
We'll leave it up to\nyou, {actor_name:1}.\nLet's save everyone.{end_wait}
So{pause_20_skippable} the people of Kolima\nwill stay trees until\nthey wither and die?{end_now}
That's right...\nWe can't leave\nthem to rot!{end_wait}
But{pause_20_skippable} how do we bring\nback the gentle Tret\nand save the village?{end_wait}
I really don't know\nwhat to do.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3}, you can't give\nup!{pause_20_skippable} Please,{pause_20_skippable} convince him\nto help!{end_wait}
Promise{pause_20_skippable} you will do\neverything in your power\nto save Kolima.{end_wait}
I was beginning to lose\nfaith in you, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
But how do we bring\nback the good Tret{page_break}and save Kolima?{end_wait}
I really have no\nidea right now...{end_wait}
I don't know yet...\nBut we have to\nthink of something.{end_wait}
Well,{pause_20_skippable} let's go.{end_wait}
Hroooom! He will not\nspeak to you, child!{end_wait}
Wait!\nWe can't let Tret\ndie like this!{end_wait}
That's right, {actor_name:1}.\nWe still need his help!{end_wait}
That's right, {actor_name:1}...{pause_20_skippable}{page_break}We have to save\neveryone in Kolima.{end_wait}
I{pause_20_skippable} turned the people\nof Kolima into trees?{end_wait}
Tret is too weak. He\ncan't save Kolima like\nthis.{end_wait}
Then we heal him!{page_break}We can't let the\npeople of Kolima die\nwith the forest.{end_wait}
Every life in Kolima\ndepends on us.{end_wait}
We restore Tret and\nsave the people\nof Kolima.{end_wait}
Try the water!{end_wait}
Surely that will\nrevive Tret.{end_wait}
Hroooom...{pause_20_skippable} Life flows\nwithin me again.{end_wait}
I am sorry to have\nworried you, Laurel.{end_wait}
And you, young ones...\nDid you not have a\nfavor to ask of me?{end_now}
{actor_name:1}! Did you forget?\nWe have to save\nthe people of Kolima!{end_wait}
Tret should be able to\ndo it now that his\nstrength is back.{end_wait}
Ask him to save\neveryone he turned\ninto a tree.{end_wait}
Please, Tret... You must\nsave those you turned\ninto trees.{end_wait}
Tret did not always\nhave this terrible\npower.{end_wait}
It began when strange\ngems fell from the sky.{end_wait}
Gems from the sky...\nDo you think he means\nthe Psynergy Stones?{end_now}
You really think the\nPsynergy Stones caused\nall of this?{end_wait}
I know you don't want\nto believe it, but\nnothing else fits...{end_wait}
Those gems fell\ninto my branches...{end_wait}
Then, all at once,\nmy fury overwhelmed me,\nand I was lost.{end_wait}
The gem reached me\nwhen I was full\nof sorrow...{end_wait}
Our actions spoke our\nhearts' desires, but we\nhad no idea...{end_wait}
Those gems twisted my\nanger into a force\nbeyond my control.{end_wait}
No... Only the elder trees\nwere touched by the\nfalling Psynergy Stones.{end_wait}
Others suffered\nthis too?{end_wait}
Then the same thing\ncould be happening\nelsewhere!{end_wait}
You must have fought\nmany monsters on your\nway here.{end_wait}
Those monsters...\nPerhaps they were only\nanimals once...{end_wait}

Once, they were pure
of heart... Hroom...{page_break}Those gems have brought
a great evil to
the world...{end_wait}
Oh! Laurel, you were\ngiven powers, too?{end_wait}
Different from mine,\nbut from the same\nsource.{end_wait}
Laurel! What are\nyou doing?{end_wait}
Wait. You will soon see.{end_wait}
What did you see, Laurel?{end_wait}
It's true{em_dash}even the\nanimals have become\nmonsters.{page_break}And beyond the river...{end_wait}
Yes... An evil forest\nhas risen south of\nthe river.{end_wait}
That area will only\ngrow more dangerous...{page_break}If you must go, hurry.{end_wait}
Good... It would be\nfoolish to risk your\nlives further.{end_wait}
May your roots go deep\nand your branches\nreach high.{end_wait}
Were you surprised,\n{actor_name:1}? We trees have\ngrown strong.{end_wait}
Oh!{pause_20_skippable} You are the ones who\nresisted Tret's glamour?{end_wait}
I sense a great warmth\nwithin you...{end_wait}
If you came to rescue\nTret, you are already\ntoo late.{end_wait}

Soon, Tret will die,
and we shall wither
away without him.{page_break}Leave now, before this
forest is destroyed...{end_wait}
